correctness.rationale: The exact Perron eigenpair of the symmetric three-state weighted adjacency yields the analytic pressure \(P_k(y)=\log(\cosh y+\sqrt{\sinh^2 y+k})\), correlation \(z_k(y)=P_k'(y)\), and a strict Legendre reduction. Differentiation gives \(N_k'(y)=\sinh y[3\sinh y\cosh y-ky]\); monotonicity of \(\sinh(2y)/(2y)\) proves the global one-turn or no-turn shape. The coexistence function satisfies \(C_k'=(z_k-yz_k')/2\), hence has exactly one positive zero for \(k>3\), while comparing global free energies excludes metastable extrema. Uniform sixth-order Taylor reduction at \(k=3\) yields the spinodal/coexistence scales \(y_s^2/(k-3)\to5/6\) and \(y_t^2/(k-3)\to5/4\), normalized threshold deviations \(-5/216\) and \(-5/288\), and correlation jump \(\sqrt{5(k-3)/12}\). The continuous-side scaled response gives the explicit crossover. The packaged checker passed 89 finite assertions; continuum and asymptotic claims depend on the analytical proof, not enumeration.

value.rationale: The 2026 unweighted example is tuned exactly to a fourth-root transition; changing the natural transition-edge weight probes structural stability without altering graph support or reflection symmetry. The theorem gives an exact whole-family global classification, a uniquely specified first-order coexistence value, two distinct metastability and coexistence scales with rational coefficients, a square-root discontinuity law, and an explicit matched continuous crossover. The result is mathematically meaningful beyond a routine substitution: it resolves the global competition not addressed by Taylor response tests and quantifies the singular perturbation scale. Scope is finite-state and exact, not an unsupported assertion for arbitrary models.
